svg.title: SiPM equivalent — microcells in parallel
svg.desc: ILLUSTRATIVE CIRCUIT / NOT ERC-VERIFIED. Representative microcell branches place a quench resistor and Geiger-mode APD between common cathode and anode rails; an ellipsis denotes additional parallel branches. Source: The DUNE Photon Detection System (Phase I), page 9.
